async function renderSeasonal(m, root) {
  const B = BD, $ = s => root.querySelector(s);
  let daily;
  try { daily = await B.daily(m.code); if (!daily || daily.length < 300) throw 0; }
  catch { $('#msg').className = 'err'; $('#msg').textContent = 'Prix indisponibles pour ce marché pour le moment. Réessayez dans une minute.'; return; }

  // ---- préparation des données (UTC) ----
  const D = daily.map(([t, c]) => { const d = new Date(t * 1e3); return { y: d.getUTCFullYear(), m: d.getUTCMonth(), day: d.getUTCDate(), d, c }; });
  const lastM = {}, byY = {}, byYM = {};
  D.forEach(p => { lastM[p.y * 12 + p.m] = p.c; (byY[p.y] ||= []).push(p); (byYM[p.y * 12 + p.m] ||= []).push(p); });
  const now = new Date(), CY = now.getUTCFullYear(), CM = now.getUTCMonth(), CD = now.getUTCDate();
  const isLeap = y => (y % 4 === 0 && y % 100 !== 0) || y % 400 === 0;
  const doy = (y, mo, d) => { let i = Math.floor((Date.UTC(y, mo, d) - Date.UTC(y, 0, 1)) / 864e5); if (isLeap(y)) i = i === 59 ? 58 : i > 59 ? i - 1 : i; return Math.min(i, 364); };
  const MS = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334], DM = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31];
  const years = Object.keys(byY).map(Number).filter(y => y < CY && byY[y].length > 200).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const lastClose = D.at(-1).c, digits = lastClose < 10 ? 4 : lastClose < 1000 ? 2 : 1;
  const fmt = v => B.dec(v, digits);

  function fill(arr, upTo) { let last = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { if (arr[i] == null) { if (upTo != null && i > upTo) arr[i] = null; else arr[i] = last; } else last = arr[i]; } return arr; }
  function yearCurve(y) {
    const base = lastM[(y - 1) * 12 + 11] ?? byY[y][0].c, c = new Array(365).fill(null); let upTo = null;
    byY[y].forEach(p => { const i = doy(y, p.m, p.day); c[i] = p.c - base; upTo = i; });
    return fill(c, y === CY ? upTo : null);
  }
  function avg(curves) { return curves[0].map((_, i) => curves.reduce((s, c) => s + c[i], 0) / curves.length); }
  function monthCurve(y, mo, upTo) {
    const base = lastM[y * 12 + mo - 1]; if (base == null || !byYM[y * 12 + mo]) return null;
    const c = new Array(DM[mo]).fill(null); let last = null;
    byYM[y * 12 + mo].forEach(p => { if (p.day - 1 < c.length) { c[p.day - 1] = p.c - base; last = p.day - 1; } });
    return fill(c, y === CY && mo === CM ? last : upTo);
  }
  const chg = (y, mo) => { const a = lastM[y * 12 + mo], b = lastM[y * 12 + mo - 1]; return a == null || b == null ? null : { pts: a - b, pct: (a - b) / b * 100 }; };

  const PER = [[20, '#e8b23a'], [15, '#ff7a45'], [10, '#a548e8'], [5, '#4da3ff'], [2, '#3ddc97']];
  const curves = {}; years.forEach(y => curves[y] = yearCurve(y));
  const avgYear = n => { const ys = years.slice(-n); return ys.length ? avg(ys.map(y => curves[y])) : null; };
  const ytd = byY[CY] ? yearCurve(CY) : null;

  // ---- textes ----
  const avgMonth = (n, mo, key = 'pts') => { const v = years.slice(-n).map(y => chg(y, mo)).filter(Boolean).map(c => c[key]); return v.length ? v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length : null; };
  const a10 = avgMonth(10, CM), mname = B.MONTHS_L[CM];
  const sentence = `En moyenne sur les 10 dernières années, le ${m.name} a varié de <b>${fmt(a10)}</b> en ${mname}.`;
  B.setInfo(`<p>Les tendances saisonnières du <b>${m.name}</b> reposent sur le contrat future. Le rapport présente la saisonnalité sur les 20, 15, 10, 5 et 2 dernières années et montre comment le marché évolue à certaines périodes de l'année ou de la semaine dans un mois.</p>
    <p>${sentence}</p>
    <p>Repérez le mois le plus haussier ou le plus baissier de l'année et adaptez votre positionnement. Les données sont recalculées automatiquement à chaque nouvelle année complète. La saisonnalité est plus fiable combinée à l'analyse fondamentale.</p>`);

  // ---- gabarit ----
  const chips = PER.map(([n, c]) => `<button class="chip ${[10, 5, 2].includes(n) ? 'on' : ''}" data-n="${n}" style="--c:${c}"><i></i>${n} ans</button>`).join('')
    + `<button class="chip on" data-n="ytd" style="--c:#ffffff"><i></i>${CY}</button>`;
  root.innerHTML = `
   <div class="sechead"><h2 class="sec">Saisonnalité annuelle – ${m.name}</h2></div>
   <div class="card"><div class="leg"><div class="chips" id="chipsY">${chips}</div>
     <div class="legkey"><span><i></i>Mois en cours</span><span><i class="d"></i>Jour en cours</span></div></div><canvas id="cYear"></canvas></div>

   <div class="sechead"><h2 class="sec">Saisonnalité de ${mname}</h2></div>
   <div class="g21">
     <div class="card"><div class="leg"><div class="chips" id="chipsM">${PER.filter(p => [10, 5, 2].includes(p[0])).map(([n, c]) => `<button class="chip on" data-n="${n}" style="--c:${c}"><i></i>${n} ans</button>`).join('')}<button class="chip on" data-n="cur" style="--c:#ffffff"><i></i>${mname} ${CY}</button></div>
     <div class="legkey"><span><i class="d"></i>Jour en cours</span></div></div><canvas id="cMonth"></canvas></div>
     <div class="kpis vert" id="kpis"></div>
   </div>

   <div class="sechead"><h2 class="sec">Variations mensuelles</h2>
     <div class="ranges" id="unit"><button class="btn on" data-u="pts">Points</button><button class="btn" data-u="pct">%</button></div></div>
   <div class="g21">
     <div class="card"><div class="tw"><table class="mon" id="tbl"></table></div></div>
     <div class="card"><h3>Variation moyenne par mois – 10 ans</h3><canvas id="cMBars"></canvas></div>
   </div>

   <div class="sechead"><h2 class="sec">Semaines et jours – ${mname}</h2></div>
   <div class="g2 top">
     <div class="col">
       <div class="card"><h3>Variations par semaine</h3><div class="tw"><table class="mon" id="wtbl" style="min-width:480px"></table></div></div>
       <div class="card"><h3>Variation moyenne par jour – 10 ans</h3><canvas id="cDay"></canvas></div>
     </div>
     <div class="card fill"><h3>Variations journalières</h3><div class="tw scroll"><table class="mon" id="dtbl" style="min-width:420px"></table></div></div>
   </div>
   <p class="note">Variation mensuelle = clôture de fin de mois − clôture du mois précédent, moyennée sur les années complètes. Courbes annuelles = évolution cumulée depuis la dernière clôture de l'année précédente, moyennée sur la période. Mise à jour automatique.</p>`;

  // ---- graphique annuel ----
  const dayLabel = i => { let mo = 11; while (MS[mo] > i) mo--; return `${i - MS[mo] + 1} ${B.MONTHS[mo].toLowerCase()}`; };
  const xt = MS.map((v, i) => [v, B.MONTHS[i]]);
  const onY = new Set([10, 5, 2, 'ytd']);
  const monthBand = { x0: MS[CM], x1: MS[CM] + DM[CM], color: 'rgba(232,178,58,.12)' }, today = { x: doy(CY, CM, CD), color: '#ff3b3b' };
  const cy = B.lineChart($('#cYear'), { series: [], xmin: 0, xmax: 364, xTicks: xt, yFmt: v => Math.abs(v) >= 1000 ? (v / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k' : +v.toFixed(2), tipHead: dayLabel, tipFmt: fmt, bands: [monthBand], vlines: [today], height: 400 });
  function paintYear() {
    const s = PER.filter(([n]) => onY.has(n)).map(([n, c]) => ({ name: n + ' ans', color: c, width: 1.8, data: (avgYear(n) || []).map((v, i) => [i, v]) }));
    if (onY.has('ytd') && ytd) s.push({ name: String(CY), color: '#ffffff', width: 1.6, dash: [5, 4], data: ytd.map((v, i) => v == null ? null : [i, v]).filter(Boolean) });
    cy.redraw({ series: s });
  }
  $('#chipsY').onclick = e => { const b = e.target.closest('.chip'); if (!b) return; const n = b.dataset.n === 'ytd' ? 'ytd' : +b.dataset.n; onY.has(n) ? onY.delete(n) : onY.add(n); b.classList.toggle('on'); paintYear(); };
  paintYear();

  // ---- graphique du mois ----
  const onM = new Set([10, 5, 2, 'cur']);
  const mcur = monthCurve(CY, CM);
  const cm = B.lineChart($('#cMonth'), { series: [], xmin: 1, xmax: DM[CM], xTicks: Array.from({ length: DM[CM] }, (_, i) => [i + 1, String(i + 1)]).filter(t => t[0] % 2 === 1),
    yFmt: v => +v.toFixed(2), tipHead: x => `${x} ${B.MONTHS[CM].toLowerCase()}`, tipFmt: fmt, vlines: [{ x: Math.min(CD, DM[CM]), color: '#ff3b3b' }], height: 300 });
  function paintMonth() {
    const s = PER.filter(([n]) => onM.has(n)).map(([n, c]) => {
      const cs = years.slice(-n).map(y => monthCurve(y, CM)).filter(Boolean);
      return { name: n + ' ans', color: c, width: 1.8, data: cs.length ? avg(cs).map((v, i) => [i + 1, v]) : [] };
    });
    if (onM.has('cur') && mcur) s.push({ name: `${B.MONTHS[CM]} ${CY}`, color: '#ffffff', width: 1.6, dash: [5, 4], data: mcur.map((v, i) => v == null ? null : [i + 1, v]).filter(Boolean) });
    cm.redraw({ series: s });
  }
  $('#chipsM').onclick = e => { const b = e.target.closest('.chip'); if (!b) return; const n = b.dataset.n === 'cur' ? 'cur' : +b.dataset.n; onM.has(n) ? onM.delete(n) : onM.add(n); b.classList.toggle('on'); paintMonth(); };
  paintMonth();

  // ---- KPIs du mois ----
  const monthSoFar = mcur ? mcur.filter(v => v != null).at(-1) : null;
  const up10 = years.slice(-10).map(y => chg(y, CM)).filter(Boolean), upN = up10.filter(c => c.pts > 0).length;
  const kp = (l, v, cls = '') => `<div class="kpi"><span>${l}</span><b class="${cls}">${v}</b></div>`;
  const cl = v => v == null ? '' : v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';
  $('#kpis').innerHTML = [10, 5, 2].map(n => { const v = avgMonth(n, CM); return kp(`Moyenne ${n} ans`, v == null ? '–' : fmt(v), cl(v)); }).join('')
    + kp('Ce mois-ci', monthSoFar == null ? '–' : fmt(monthSoFar), cl(monthSoFar)) + kp(`Hausse en ${mname} (10 a.)`, `${upN}/${up10.length}`);

  // ---- tableau mensuel + barres ----
  let unit = 'pts';
  const cells = n => Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, mo) => avgMonth(n, mo, unit));
  const f2 = v => v == null ? '–' : unit === 'pct' ? B.dec(v, 2) + '%' : fmt(v);
  function paintTable() {
    $('#tbl').innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th>Période</th>${B.MONTHS.map((x, i) => `<th class="${i === CM ? 'cur' : ''}">${x}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>`
      + PER.map(([n]) => `<tr><td>${n} ans</td>${cells(n).map((v, i) => `<td class="${(v == null ? '' : v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg')} ${i === CM ? 'cur' : ''}">${f2(v)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('') + '</tbody>';
    B.bars($('#cMBars'), cells(10).map((v, i) => ({ label: B.MONTHS[i], v: v || 0, color: (v || 0) >= 0 ? '#0f8a55' : '#b3202f' })), 210, false);
  }
  // Variation par semaine du mois en cours : blocs 1-7, 8-14, 15-21, 22-28, 29-fin.
  function paintWeeks() {
    const dm = DM[CM], blocks = []; for (let st = 1; st <= dm; st += 7) blocks.push([st, Math.min(st + 6, dm)]);
    const weekVals = (c, base, lastDay) => blocks.map(([a, e], k) => {
      if (lastDay < a) return null;
      const end = c[Math.min(e, lastDay) - 1], start = k ? c[blocks[k - 1][1] - 1] : 0, d = end - start;
      return unit === 'pct' ? d / base * 100 : d;
    });
    const avgW = n => {
      const acc = blocks.map(() => []);
      years.slice(-n).forEach(y => { const c = monthCurve(y, CM); if (!c) return; weekVals(c, lastM[y * 12 + CM - 1], c.length).forEach((v, k) => v != null && acc[k].push(v)); });
      return acc.map(a => a.length ? a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length : null);
    };
    const curWk = blocks.findIndex(([a, e]) => CD >= a && CD <= e);
    const cls = (v, k) => `${v == null ? '' : v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg'} ${k === curWk ? 'cur' : ''}`;
    let cur = null;
    if (mcur) { const last = mcur.filter(v => v != null).length; cur = weekVals(mcur, lastM[CY * 12 + CM - 1], last); }
    $('#wtbl').innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th>Période</th>${blocks.map(([a, e], k) => `<th class="${k === curWk ? 'cur' : ''}">Sem. ${k + 1}<br><small>${a}–${e} ${B.MONTHS[CM].toLowerCase()}</small></th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>`
      + PER.map(([n]) => `<tr><td>${n} ans</td>${avgW(n).map((v, k) => `<td class="${cls(v, k)}">${f2(v)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')
      + (cur ? `<tr><td>${CY}</td>${cur.map((v, k) => `<td class="${cls(v, k)}">${f2(v)}${k === curWk && v != null ? ' <small>(en cours)</small>' : ''}</td>`).join('')}</tr>` : '') + '</tbody>';
  }
  // Variation journalière : clôture du jour − clôture de la séance précédente, regroupée par jour du mois.
  const dayChg = {};
  for (let i = 1; i < D.length; i++) { const p = D[i], k = p.y * 12 + p.m; ((dayChg[k] ||= {})[p.day] = { pts: p.c - D[i - 1].c, pct: (p.c / D[i - 1].c - 1) * 100 }); }
  function paintDays() {
    const dm = DM[CM], key = unit === 'pct' ? 'pct' : 'pts';
    const avgD = n => Array.from({ length: dm }, (_, i) => {
      const v = years.slice(-n).map(y => dayChg[y * 12 + CM]?.[i + 1]?.[key]).filter(x => x != null);
      return v.length ? v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length : null;
    });
    const cols = PER.map(([n]) => avgD(n)), cur = Array.from({ length: dm }, (_, i) => dayChg[CY * 12 + CM]?.[i + 1]?.[key] ?? null);
    const c = v => v == null ? '' : v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';
    $('#dtbl').innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th>Jour</th>${PER.map(([n]) => `<th>${n} ans</th>`).join('')}<th>${CY}</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
      + Array.from({ length: dm }, (_, i) => `<tr class="${i + 1 === CD ? 'cur' : ''}"><td>${i + 1} ${B.MONTHS[CM].toLowerCase()}</td>${cols.map(col => `<td class="${c(col[i])} ${i + 1 === CD ? 'cur' : ''}">${f2(col[i])}</td>`).join('')}<td class="${c(cur[i])} ${i + 1 === CD ? 'cur' : ''}">${f2(cur[i])}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody>';
    const b10 = cols[2];
    B.bars($('#cDay'), b10.map((v, i) => ({ label: String(i + 1), v: v || 0, color: (v || 0) >= 0 ? '#0f8a55' : '#b3202f' })), 200, false);
  }
  $('#unit').onclick = e => { const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return; unit = b.dataset.u; [...$('#unit').children].forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); paintTable(); paintWeeks(); paintDays(); };
  paintTable(); paintWeeks(); paintDays();
  addEventListener('resize', () => paintDays());
  addEventListener('resize', () => B.bars($('#cMBars'), cells(10).map((v, i) => ({ label: B.MONTHS[i], v: v || 0, color: (v || 0) >= 0 ? '#0f8a55' : '#b3202f' })), 210, false));
}
